paragraphs: Mentioned in Bamidbar Rabbah 3:8; Rabbi Huna the Priest reports in his name.

notes.text: The abbreviated work label מ״ר does not by itself specify which book of Midrash Rabbah is intended.

The saved named Torat Emet Bamidbar Rabbah 3:8 scalar explicitly has Rabbi Huna the Priest reporting in the name of Rabbi Shmuel bar Zeira. This exact chain supports Bamidbar Rabbah for supplied במ״ר and corrects the earlier local generic-book uncertainty. No further identity or chronology is inferred.

Hyman’s printed page (vol. III, p. 1136) gives במ״ר פ״ג־ח. In the Torat Emet text of Bamidbar Rabbah 3:8, Rabbi Huna the Priest reports twice in the name of Rabbi Shmuel bar Zeira, first on why the Levites are counted from one month of age and then on how Scripture counts Samuel’s years of judging Israel.
